PDFSHEETS.NoPDFSelected: No PDF selected. Click the Select/Change PDF button in the header.
PDFSHEETS.StorageNotAvailable: PDF Sheet storage is not available. A GM must log in once to initialize it.
PDFSHEETS.SourceNotFound: Could not find the PDF source to download.
PDFSHEETS.Settings.BackgroundColor.Name: PDF Viewer Background Color
PDFSHEETS.Settings.BackgroundColor.Hint: Changes the color around the PDF page. Leave blank for the default viewer color.
PDFSHEETS.Settings.HighlightColor.Name: Form Field Background Color
PDFSHEETS.Settings.HighlightColor.Hint: Changes the highlight color of fillable PDF form fields. Leave blank for default.
PDFSHEETS.Settings.TextColor.Name: Form Field Text Color
PDFSHEETS.Settings.TextColor.Hint: Changes the text color inside fillable PDF form fields. Leave blank for default.
PDFSHEETS.Settings.SaveOnClose.Name: Enable Save on Close
PDFSHEETS.Settings.SaveOnClose.Hint: If enabled, the PDF sheet will be automatically saved when the window is closed. Warning: If the same sheet is open on multiple clients, the last one to close will overwrite any changes made by others. Disable this if you prefer to save manually.
